dynamic_variables.objective: Schedule a repair appointment for Dana Kirkwood's car - the brakes have been squealing for about a week.
dynamic_variables.opening_line: I am calling to book a repair appointment for Dana Kirkwood's car, the brakes have been squealing.
dynamic_variables.constraints: CONSTRAINTS: No appointment before 9 AM, at most $250 for the inspection, do not promise a deposit.
dynamic_variables.background:
BACKGROUND (for your information only):
- What it's about: The brakes have been squealing for about a week and Dana Kirkwood wants them looked at soon.
- Relationship to the person being called: New customer, first time at this shop.
- Desired outcome: A firm morning appointment within the next two weeks.
- Key facts: Dana Kirkwood drops the car off and does not wait on site; the assignment carries no details about the vehicle itself
This background is for you; only pass on what the task requires.
dynamic_variables.mandate: Any weekday appointment within the next two weeks, mornings preferred, up to $250 for the inspection. The assignment says nothing about the vehicle itself.
dynamic_variables.callee_timezone: The person you are calling is probably in the America/Chicago time zone. That is an assumption derived from their area code, it is not confirmed, and it may be wrong. Before you name any specific time, confirm it in one short sentence, for example: "I have you down as Central time - is that right?" Once they have confirmed it, convert every time you agree between those two zones and say which zone you mean.
